# load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library (ggthemes)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(stats)
library(lmerTest)
```

# import data
```{r}
## read data
data <- read_csv('data/replication_data.csv')

ncol(data)
colnames(data)
```

# basic descriptives
```{r}
## N(initial) = 80
length(data %>% pull(subject) %>% unique())

## number of trials per subject = 338
data %>% group_by(subject) %>% count()
```

# data treatment


##comprehension scores **note this is based on coding bug
```{r}
comprehension_scores <- data %>% group_by(subject) %>%
  filter(typeoftrial=="comprehension") %>% count(response==comprehension_type) %>%
   pivot_wider(names_from = c(2), values_from = n) 

comprehension_scores <- comprehension_scores %>% rename(correct = "FALSE") %>%
  mutate(comp = correct/24)

inaccurate_comp <- comprehension_scores %>% filter(comp < 0.8)

```

## exclusions
```{r}
##exclude filler, practice, and non-picture trials
exclusions_data <- data %>% 
  filter(typeoftrial=="picture" & !(trialcondition %in% c("filler", "practice", "practice_n", "practice_s"))) %>%
  ##exclude bad comprehension
  filter(!subject %in% inaccurate_comp$subject) %>%
  separate(trialcondition, into = c("weight", "state")) 
```


# accuracy analyses

## accuracy data
```{r}
# calculate subject accuracy
subject_accuracy <- exclusions_data %>% group_by(subject) %>%
      summarise(TaskAccuracy=mean(correct))

InaccurateSubjects <- subject_accuracy %>% filter(TaskAccuracy < 0.8)
```

## plot
```{r}
exclusions_data %>% 
  group_by(weight, state) %>%
   summarise(ci = list(mean_cl_boot(correct) %>% 
                        rename(mean=y, lwr=ymin, upr=ymax))) %>% unnest%>%
  ggplot(aes(x= weight, y = mean, group = state, fill = state)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7, color = "gray24")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lwr, ymax=upr), size = 0.5, width=.15, 
                color = "black", position = position_dodge(0.70))+
  labs(y = "mean accuracy", title = "accuracy by condition")+
  theme_clean()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darksalmon", "darkslategray4","darkolivegreen4"))+
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(
    color = "white"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size =rel(2)),
        axis.text = element_text(size =rel(1.5)),
        axis.title = element_text(size =rel(2)),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, size = rel(1.5)))
```

## main accuracy model
```{r}
acc_model = glmer(data = exclusions_data, 
                  correct ~ weight + state + (1|subject) + (1|stimulus),
                  family = "binomial")
summary(acc_model)
car::Anova(acc_model)
```
 
# RT analyses

## rt data
```{r}
##exclude incorrect responses
rt_data <- exclusions_data %>% filter(correct==1) %>%
  ##exclude subjects with accuracy < 80%
  filter(!subject %in% InaccurateSubjects$subject)

length(rt_data %>% pull(subject) %>% unique())
```
 
## log10 transformation & histograms
```{r}
rt_data <- rt_data %>% mutate(rt = as.numeric(rt)) %>% mutate(log10_rt=log(rt, 10))

rt_data %>%  filter(rt <10000) %>% ggplot(aes(x=rt)) + geom_histogram(binwidth =20, fill="pink" ) + theme_economist() + labs(x="RT (ms)", y="frequency", title= "RT histogram")

rt_data %>%  ggplot(aes(x=log10_rt)) + geom_histogram(binwidth =0.1, fill="pink" ) + theme_economist() + labs(x="log10(rt)", y="frequency", title= "RT histogram")
```

## MAD exclusions

```{r}
mad_data = rt_data %>%
  group_by(weight, state) %>%
  mutate(MAD=3*mad(log10_rt), med=median(log10_rt),
         L= (med - MAD), U=(med + MAD)) %>%
  filter(log10_rt < U) %>% filter(log10_rt > L)

(nrow(data)-nrow(mad_data))/nrow(data)

 length(mad_data %>% pull(subject) %>% unique())
```

## plot
```{r}
mad_data %>% 
  group_by(weight, state) %>%
   summarise(ci = list(mean_cl_boot(rt) %>% 
                        rename(mean=y, lwr=ymin, upr=ymax))) %>% unnest%>%
  ggplot(aes(x= weight, y = mean, group = state, fill = state)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7, color = "gray24")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lwr, ymax=upr), size = 0.5, width=.15, 
                color = "black", position = position_dodge(0.70))+
  labs(y = "log10(rt)", title = "log10(rt) per condition")+
  theme_clean()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darksalmon", "darkslategray4","darkolivegreen4"))+
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(
    color = "white"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size =rel(2)),
        axis.text = element_text(size =rel(1.5)),
        axis.title = element_text(size =rel(2)),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, size = rel(1.5)))
```

## main RT model
```{r}
rt_model = lmer(data = mad_data, 
                log10_rt ~ weight*state + (weight |subject) + (1|stimulus))
summary(rt_model)
car::Anova(rt_model)
```

### assumptions
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
sjPlot::plot_model(rt_model, type='diag')
sjPlot::plot_model(rt_model, type='resid')
```
